confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough: cost-of-living and nightlife sites disagree by up to about 2x and several are crowdsourced, so I bounded each figure across the sources. Cocktail and wine were partly set from the local beer relationship because direct figures were weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no accommodation search and no inspection of live listings. The FX observation (0.6720 on 2026-11-18) came from search-result text that attributed it to RBA pages; I did not open the RBA page or the F11.1 table, so it needs verification against the official RBA file.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized coastal northern Chilean city, priced against Latin American and Chilean regional benchmarks (Iquique and Antofagasta-type cities). Cost-of-living indexes place Arica below Santiago, so the anchors sit below Santiago levels. Food pricing is based on Chilean peso price ranges converted at roughly 900 to 950 CLP per USD.
